scenes.row: Scene 501 | Orchard | 20:00-21:00 | starlight rigging beside hedge

sources.name: C_ORCHARD-permit.txt
sources.text:
The historical exhibition caption describes last season's orchard photographs showing a leather ground blanket and a retired arborist; these are reference images, not current filming conditions.

An unsigned proposal for Scene 502 asks for a drone survey with a radio spotter and a signed aviation waiver; this proposal creates no current requirement or approval.

Scene 501 starlight rigging requires a current written estate access licence and a staffed wildlife lookout beside the hedge for the entire take.

Background correspondence asks whether Scene 502 could borrow the earlier conditions; no issued replacement is supplied in this correspondence.
